title: BGW circuit evaluation
statement: Given a degree-$d$ resharer $R$, a finite set $A$ of parties, and party-indexed input shares for each input label, evaluate a circuit over $F$ as a party-indexed assignment: inputs use their supplied shares, constants are shared uniformly as the constant, addition and scalar multiplication act pointwise, and multiplication is followed by the degree-reduction map defined using $R$ and $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
Input shares are supplied for every input label and party
